project.title: Launch of Integrated Online Campaign for New Printed Catalog Service
project.objective: Plan and launch a digital-first campaign to promote a new customized printed catalog service, aligning online acquisition with print production capabilities.
deliverables: Campaign strategy for promoting the printed catalog service
Channel-specific media plan and budget allocation
Creative asset kit aligned with print production specs
Landing page brief and tracking requirements
Sales enablement toolkit for technical sales representatives
constraints: Campaign must go live within 21 days
All creatives must comply with print production and brand guidelines
Budget cap for media spend cannot be exceeded
Tracking must use existing analytics and CRM stack
Sales scripts must not promise print specs we cannot produce
All customer-facing copy must be legally and compliance reviewed

risks.risk: Misalignment between online offer and what print production can actually deliver.
risks.mitigation: Have imagesetter review specs and proof key creatives before launch.

risks.risk: Campaign underperforms due to unclear value proposition of printed catalogs.
risks.mitigation: Test multiple value props and refine based on early performance data.

risks.risk: Sales team not fully prepared to handle new catalog inquiries.
risks.mitigation: Provide concise sales playbook, FAQ, and short enablement session before launch.

risks.risk: Tracking gaps lead to incomplete performance data.
risks.mitigation: Align on tracking requirements early and run test traffic before full launch.

themes.why_relevant: Need a smooth path from digital interest to ordering physical printed catalogs.
Digital creatives must accurately reflect print capabilities and limitations.
Technical sales representatives must confidently pitch and scope catalog jobs.
Deciding how to split spend across paid social, search, and email.
Define KPIs, tracking, and how to iterate post-launch.
Set realistic timelines and quality expectations for printed catalogs.

backlog.task: Define campaign objectives, target segments, and core value proposition
definition_of_done: Written brief with SMART objectives approved by marketing manager
Target personas and segments documented
Primary and secondary value propositions agreed

backlog.task: Draft channel strategy and media plan for digital promotion
definition_of_done: Media plan spreadsheet completed with channels, budgets, and timelines
Attribution approach defined
Plan shared and acknowledged by sales and production stakeholders

backlog.task: Create creative asset requirements and coordinate with print production
definition_of_done: List of required asset formats and specs documented
Print feasibility of sample creatives confirmed
Feedback loop with marketing established

backlog.task: Develop copy and creatives for ads, email, and landing page brief
definition_of_done: Draft copy for each channel completed
Creative concepts aligned with print specs
Compliance review requested for all customer-facing text

backlog.task: Prepare sales playbook and FAQ for catalog service
definition_of_done: Sales pitch outline written
FAQ with at least 15 common questions drafted
Playbook reviewed by online marketer and imagesetter for accuracy

backlog.task: Define lead handling workflow from online form to sales follow-up
definition_of_done: Lead routing rules documented
Response time targets defined
Workflow validated with customer support and CRM owner

backlog.task: Set up tracking, UTM structure, and reporting dashboard requirements
definition_of_done: UTM taxonomy documented
Tracking events and goals listed
Reporting dashboard requirements shared with analytics owner

backlog.task: Run pre-launch QA on creatives, links, and print claims
definition_of_done: All creatives checked for accurate print specs and imagery
All links and forms tested
Issues logged and resolved or accepted with rationale

backlog.task: Train sales team on new catalog offer and lead handling process
definition_of_done: Training agenda prepared
Session delivered or async materials shared
Attendance or acknowledgment recorded

backlog.task: Launch campaign and monitor first 72 hours performance
definition_of_done: Campaigns activated across planned channels
Initial performance metrics captured
Early optimization actions documented

backlog.task: Collect qualitative feedback from first 10 catalog customers
definition_of_done: At least 10 customer conversations or surveys completed
Key insights summarized
Improvement suggestions shared with marketing and production

backlog.task: Compile post-launch performance and recommendations report
definition_of_done: Report with KPIs, learnings, and next steps drafted
Input from sales and production incorporated
Report shared with core stakeholders

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on campaign objectives, target segments, and value proposition
threads_plan.trigger: Online marketer shares first draft of A1 Campaign Strategy and Brief for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve or adjust primary campaign objective and KPIs.
Select 1–2 priority target segments for launch.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock channel mix, budget split, and launch timeline
threads_plan.trigger: Online marketer posts initial media plan from A2 and proposed go-live date.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm channel mix and budget allocation per channel.
Agree on final campaign launch date within the 21-day window.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Validate creative concepts against print capabilities and finalize specs
threads_plan.trigger: Imagesetter reviews early creative mockups and A3 guidelines with marketing.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve final creative and print specification guidelines.
Decide which print features can be promoted in ads and landing page.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalize sales playbook, lead workflow, and training approach
threads_plan.trigger: Technical sales representative shares draft A4 playbook and A6 workflow for comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve sales playbook structure and key messaging.
Confirm lead routing rules and response time SLAs.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review early performance, customer feedback, and next optimizations
threads_plan.trigger: Online marketer posts initial metrics and draft A8 post-launch report.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in post with yesterday's progress and today's focus
Twice-weekly performance snapshot after launch with key metrics and actions
Pre-launch QA sign-off thread using A5 checklist before any go-live
Weekly cross-functional sync summary post capturing decisions and blockers
